title: Light Blue Account features and fees
summary: Light Blue Account features and fees list a $0.00 monthly maintenance fee and $0.00 overdraft/overdraft protection transfer fees, plus 2 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals per month and a $2.50 fee for each additional withdrawal. It also includes a $30 stop payment fee, 0% APY, a $400 daily ATM withdrawal limit (per 24-hour period), and $0.00 paper statement, returned deposit, and incoming domestic wire fees.
